crossing: Checkout offers the store's enabled payment methods
what_crosses: data (list of method slugs the buyer may use)

Fact: a real order.updated lists accepted_payment_methods including per-account slugs such as bank_1572588. Inference: core needs only the computed list; how it is computed (plan, KYC, rules) can stay inside payments.

crossing: Amount, currency and price breakdown handed to payments
what_crosses: data (total_to_pay; sub_total, shipping, discounts, tax, COD fee, currency, exchange rate)
mechanism: API field: cart total_to_pay; order amounts object, currency, exchange_rate, scope_exchange_rate
decided_by: platform computes from merchant pricing, tax, shipping and promotion settings
quote: «Root-level total_to_pay is the amount to be paid.» — original English
notes: Fact: amounts carries tax {percent, amount}, cash_on_delivery, discounts and exchange_rate {base_currency, exchange_currency, rate}. Inference: the single most important core-to-payments contract; tax, discount and shipping arithmetic stays in core and payments receives a finished amount.

crossing: Cart hands over to Salla's hosted checkout for payment
what_crosses: command (redirect buyer to hosted checkout)
mechanism: API field checkout_url on the cart; Checkout APIs deliberately exclude payment submission
evidence: https://docs.salla.dev/checkout-apis/overview.md line 10 and https://docs.salla.dev/checkout-apis/key-concepts.md line 13 (captured 2026-10-06; overview live copy identical 2026-10-10)
quote: «It does not include payment submission or full checkout-step orchestration endpoints in this module.» — original English
notes: Fact: key concepts say to use checkout_url to redirect to hosted checkout; abandoned-cart webhooks and order remaining_action also carry a checkout URL. Inference: this is where Salla's seam is narrowest - headless clients never touch payment submission.

crossing: Payment submission outcome decides whether an order exists
what_crosses: event (submitted / succeeded / failed / offline method chosen) leading to order creation and thank-you page
mechanism: hosted checkout POST /{lang}/checkout/{token}/payments/submit then /thankyou/{id}; rejected attempts stay in the e-payment transactions log
evidence: raw/runs/20261009T110431Z-journey-storefront-guest-order-en/steps/031.text.txt:33 and steps/034.text.txt:22 (2026-10-09); https://help.salla.sa/article/x/d9me3k8vqi09hdiun8r2ngfr (help, fetched 2026-10-10; page updated 29 Sep 2026)
quote: «العمليات المرفوضة ستظهر في عمليات الدفع الإلكتروني.» — EN: Rejected operations will appear in the e-payment transactions log.
notes: Fact: the COD guest order became #292850582 right after 'Confirm payment'. Fact (Salla Point help): 'في حال فشل الدفع فلا يتم إكمال الطلب'. Inference: failed card attempts never become orders; offline methods (bank, COD) create the order before money moves.

crossing: Order's first status is set from the payment class (auto-complete per e-payment, COD, BNPL)
what_crosses: data (payment class of the order) mapped to an order status
mechanism: setting orders.auto_complete {epayment, cod, instalments} with excluded product types; default under_review
quote: «تعيين حالة "تم التنفيذ" عند الطلب بالدفع الإلكتروني» — EN (Salla's own): Set status to "Completed" for online-paid orders
notes: Fact: under_review applies to bank transfer and COD, and to e-payments when the toggle is off (orders settings.complete_customization.form.under_review_desc). Fact: help v5jr recommends the toggle so digital products and cards are delivered at once. Fact: the observed COD order showed 'تم التنفيذ' immediately. Inference: mapping payment result to first status is generic; per-class toggles are Salla's.

crossing: Thank-you page and buyer messages change with payment state
what_crosses: data (payment state: awaiting payment / under review / completed) selecting a merchant message
mechanism: storefront config order_instruction {order_instructions_payment_waiting, _under_review, _completed}; setting order-confirmation-page
lifecycle_point: checkout: thank-you page; buyer order page
decided_by: merchant writes the texts; platform picks by state
quote:
«طلبك حالياً غير مؤكد !
نأمل تأكيد الدفع عبر الرابط المرسل لجوالك» — EN: Your order is not confirmed yet! Please confirm payment via the link sent to your phone.
notes: Fact: pending_payment message is 'shown when the customer chooses deferred payment'. Inference: core needs a small payment-state enum, not payment details, to render these pages.

crossing: Payment restriction rules read cart, customer, product and market context

crossing: Payment methods and guest checkout configured per market

notes: Fact: markets also switch tax by market country (settings markets#tax_restriction). Inference: any cross-border store needs per-country method availability; market is a core concept payments must read.

crossing: Saved cards are tied to the buyer's account

notes: Fact: not supported in quick purchase; card and address saving are listed inside Salla's 'checkout experience fee'. Inference: payments needs only a stable customer id; card data stays inside payments.

crossing: Express purchase from the product page bypasses the cart

crossing: Payment-method coupons and bank-card offers depend on the chosen method or card issuer
what_crosses: data (selected payment method; card bank and card type)
mechanism: coupon type 'payment-method' and condition payment_methods; Checkout API coupon payment_method parameter; bank offers (bank_id, card types)

Inference: needs a BIN-to-bank lookup from payments; promotions engine must re-price after method choice.

crossing: Order acknowledgement shown only when cash on delivery is chosen
what_crosses: data (selected payment method)
mechanism: setting order acknowledgement: always / when COD chosen / hidden
quote: «حدد متى تريد أن يظهر الإقرار (يظهر دائماً، يظهر عد اختيار الدفع عند الاستلام، إخفاء الإقرار)» — EN: Choose when the acknowledgement shows (always, when cash on delivery is chosen, hidden).
notes: Fact: quick purchase skips the acknowledgement (help jpui).

crossing: Business-purchase details entered at the payment step go onto the invoice
what_crosses: data (company name, VAT number, commercial registration)

notes: Fact: settings description says the data is documented on the order invoice. Inference: B2B tax invoices are required in VAT jurisdictions; the field belongs to order/invoice data even though it is captured on the payment page.

crossing: Bank transfer: receiving account shown, receipt uploaded, merchant reviews
what_crosses: data + status (receiving bank account; receipt image; sender name; order under_review)
mechanism: checkout bank-transfer form; order fields receipt_image and bank; status under_review; dashboard 'Payment receipt'
decided_by: buyer transfers and uploads; merchant verifies and changes status
quote: «Upload your bank transfer receipt and enter the sender's name so we can verify your payment.» — original English (storefront /en)
notes: Fact: the order showed 'بانتظار المراجعه' and 'Partially paid' after placement (steps/096 lines 20, 38). Fact: receiving accounts (shown to buyers) differ from the payout account tied to verification (help bhrr). Inference: the generic need is an offline payment confirmed by the merchant; the receipt image is regional practice.

crossing: Deferred payment window ('Give me 24 hours') and due-date extension
what_crosses: status/data (payment_pending, is_pending_payment, pending_payment_ends_at); command back (extend due date)
mechanism: checkout option; setting orders.disable_bank_transfer_payment_period; order action extend_payment_due
decided_by: buyer defers; merchant disables or extends
quote: «سيتوجب على العميل إتمام التحويل البنكي وإرفاق الإيصال لإتمام الطلب.» — EN (Salla's own): Customers must complete the bank transfer and upload the receipt when placing the order.
notes: Fact: the checkout offered 'Give me 24 hours' (run 20261009T112238Z steps/036.text.txt:32). Fact: a real delivery had pending_payment_start_at and pending_payment_ends_at. What happens at expiry is not evidenced (see notes).

crossing: Payment link for unpaid, manual and price-quote orders
what_crosses: command (create, copy or send a payment link; SMS)
mechanism: order actions Send/Copy payment link; Order Actions API send_payment_link; order remaining_action.checkout_url
quote: «سيتم ارسال سعر الطلب عبر رسالة نصية تلقائياً بعد عدة دقائق إلى عميلك، وتحتوي على رابط الدفع.» — EN: The order price is sent to your customer by SMS after a few minutes, with the payment link.
notes: Fact: a manual order saved as Unpaid became 'بإنتظار الدفع' with 'Send the payment link to the customer from Order Actions.' Fact: request_quote is a base status (order-statuses items.jsonl:12).

crossing: One order, several payments (split tender and partial payments)

mechanism: API field order payment_methods; payment status Fully paid / Partially paid / Unpaid; partial payment with proof upload
quote: «تم استلام الدفعة الأولى من العميل» — EN (Salla's own): First payment received from the customer
notes: Fact: example order paid 146 by bank and 50 by customer_wallet. Fact: partial-payments flag (Plus+) was not enabled on either captured store (dashboard-features merchant@en items.jsonl:326). Inference: the order must hold a list of payments, not one method.

crossing: Editing a paid order creates a balance due or a refund
what_crosses: data/command (new total; difference to collect or refund)
mechanism: order edit (merchant, or buyer under customer-editing policy) then remaining amount + payment link, or 'refund the difference'; webhook order.total.price.updated; storefront 'Pay difference' button
decided_by: merchant or buyer (edit); buyer pays difference
quote: «فارق المبلغ الناتج عن تعديل الطلب: {{amount}}» — EN (Salla's own): Difference due to order update: {{amount}}
notes: Fact: help says the difference may be paid by a different method than the original (e.g. Mada first, Tamara for the difference). Inference: requires order-level balance tracking that both modules agree on.

crossing: Cash-on-delivery eligibility rules read the cart and customer
what_crosses: data (order value, cart weight, products, categories, customer ban status)
mechanism: setting shipping.cod (min/max order value, max weight, excluded products and categories, hide for banned customers) plus platform caps (SAR 20 minimum, SAR 1,000 maximum with Salla labels)
quote: «حدِّد الشروط التي تُعطِّل ظهور خيار الدفع عند الاستلام في صفحة إتمام الطلب.» — EN (Salla's own): Set the conditions that disable the cash on delivery option at checkout.
notes: Fact: COD rules live in Shipping settings, not Payments. Fact: help says COD is hidden below SAR 20 even when enabled. Inference: COD is a regional practice; essential only if Sharrwah serves the same markets.

crossing: COD availability depends on the delivery choice (carrier, zone, branch)
what_crosses: data (shipping required?, carrier COD on/off, zone COD fee, branch is_cod_available); shipping lookups filtered by payment_method
mechanism: shipping zone cash_on_delivery {status, fees}; branch is_cod_available and cod_cost; GET /store/v1/shipping/cities and /districts with payment_method
quote: «الدفع عند التسليم غير متاح لعدم وجود بيانات الشحن.» — EN: Cash on delivery is not available because there are no shipping details.
notes: Fact: payments page warns 'Make sure cash on delivery is enabled in your shipping carrier settings' (payments.json cod.shipping_notice). Fact: storefront branches carry is_cod_available (structures/salla/storefront-api/branches@demo-ar/items.jsonl:1, 2026-10-06). Inference: tight two-way coupling between COD and shipping.

crossing: COD fee is added to the order total and taxed
what_crosses: data (COD fee; VAT on the fee) into order amounts
mechanism: order amounts.cash_on_delivery; checkout 'Cash on delivery + fee'; carrier pricing COD fee, which the merchant may raise or lower
decided_by: merchant sets fee; carrier sets base fee

notes: Fact: checkout showed 'Cash on delivery + 13'; the order showed COD fees 11.3 and VAT 15%. Inference: 13 is VAT-inclusive. Fact: a lower fee than the carrier's is deducted from the merchant's balance.

crossing: Shipment tells the carrier to collect cash, and how much
what_crosses: data (payment_method = cod; cash_on_delivery amount) on the shipment
mechanism: API field on shipment model; shipment webhooks; Shipments & Fulfillment APIs for shipping apps

notes: Inference: needed whenever COD is offered; carriers and shipping apps never see card data, only the COD amount.

crossing: Carrier COD remittance and payout to the merchant

notes: Fact: the invoice covers orders whose status is delivered or shipped; COD fees and VAT on fees are deducted. Fact: with carriers outside Salla labels, 'لا تتولى سلة تحصيل مبالغ الدفع عند الاستلام' - settlement is direct between merchant and carrier, so only the order and shipment carry the amount.

crossing: Cross-store risk signals hide cash on delivery
what_crosses: data (buyer banned in other Salla stores; non-serious flag; ban reasons incl. payment delay)

quote: «سيُخفى خيار الدفع عند الاستلام عن العملاء المحظورين في متاجر سلة الأخرى.» — EN (Salla's own): Cash on delivery will be hidden for customers banned from other Salla stores.

crossing: Per-order settlement state shown on the order
what_crosses: data (amount added to e-payments balance; paid out under e-payment invoice #)

notes: Inference: essential when the platform is the payment facilitator; a reference id is enough for the order side.

crossing: Payout schedule depends on the merchant's plan

mechanism: payout-cycle setting with plan lock; minimum payout SAR 100; payout to the verified bank account

quote: «التحويل {{dailySuffix}} غير متاح في باقة {{plan}}. رقِّ باقتك للوصول إلى خيارات أسرع.» — EN (Salla's own): {{dailySuffix}} payouts aren't available on the {{plan}} plan. Upgrade for faster payout options.
notes: Fact: payouts go to the account tied to store verification, which buyers never see (help bhrr). Inference: monetisation lever, not a commerce need.

crossing: Payment fees and VAT on fees reach Salla's tax invoice to the merchant

mechanism: fees deducted before payout; monthly purchases tax invoice; fee calculator

notes: Fact: the checkout experience fee covers card and address saving, Apple Pay express checkout and fraud protection. Inference: Salla's fee model.

crossing: Refunds are funded from the payments balance
what_crosses: command (refund) checked against the merchant's e-payments balance
mechanism: PUT /transactions/{id} action refund (422 when balance is short); dashboard refund; after payout the refund is the merchant's job
evidence: https://docs.salla.dev/transactions/update.md lines 25 and 204 (captured 2026-10-06; live copy identical 2026-10-10); structures/salla/dashboard-translations/ar/orders.json:1 key payment.balance.refund_by_merchant (2026-10-08)
quote: «لايمكن إرجاع العملية بمبلغ 900ر.س لعدم وجود رصيد كافي في رصيد المدفوعات» — EN: The SAR 900 operation cannot be refunded because the payments balance is insufficient.

crossing: Shipping labels are paid from the store wallet and/or the e-payments balance

mechanism: setting shipping-label-deduction (wallet and e-payments / wallet only); label blocked on low balance; postpaid credit limit

notes: Inference: a Salla shipping promotion that uses the merchant balance as its payout rail.

crossing: Store wallet pays for platform services; withdrawals need verification and no open complaints

notes: Fact: add-on checkout applies VAT (checkout-modules-add-ons.md line 11). Inference: a second payments use (platform as merchant of record) that shares rails with buyer payments.

notes: Fact: requirement 'Store active for at least 12 months'. Inference: financing is netted inside payouts; core only supplies store history.
